answer: Charge a refundable, time-locked deposit that is returned only if the identity stays economically distinct. Every epoch, counterparties and funding sources are plotted on a shared atlas; when several names share the same root wallet or move in lockstep, they are folded into one party and the deposit is forfeited. A rotating falcon reviewer, chosen at random and paid from the slashed pool, inspects a sample of those links. Policy weight is then set to the remaining delta: unique counterparties times bonded stake, not the raw headcount of labels.
